title: State 988 Coordinator: "Who Am I Talking To for Decisions?"

caller.name: Hannah Lindqvist
caller.label: State 988 Coordinator, Nebraska Division of Behavioral Health

callee.name: Dr. Wilhelmina Strand
callee.label: Executive Director, Great Plains Crisis Network

transcript.speaker: State 988 Coordinator
transcript.text: Dr. Wilhelmina Strand, it's Hannah Lindqvist at the Division. I've confirmed your routing request with the network desk, so that part is on the record now.

transcript.speaker: State 988 Coordinator
transcript.text: But I still don't have the written status I asked you for by 15:00. It's ten to four. The Governor's office briefs at 16:15, and right now all I can tell them is what I'm reading on social media.

transcript.speaker: State 988 Coordinator
transcript.text: Here's what I need. Your surge level. Waits for calls, texts and chats, separately. What backup is running, and since when. And anything I should know about the text platform, because I'm hearing it's having trouble.

transcript.speaker: State 988 Coordinator
transcript.text: And one more thing. Who am I talking to for decisions? You, or the floor supervisor? I've had a request from one of you and silence from the other, and I can't brief the Governor's office on that.

transcript.speaker: State 988 Coordinator
transcript.text: All right. Then I need it in writing in my inbox by 16:05. Numbers only, no contact detail. I'll be at my desk until the briefing.

transcript.speaker: Text message, Dana Whitcomb, state backup center supervisor, to the surge commander's phone, 15:47
transcript.text: We're in the shared queue and taking texts, but they're landing in bursts, and two arrived that one of yours had already picked up. Is that your platform? Do I keep going?

transcript.speaker: Note from the quiet room, handed to the raised desk, 15:51
transcript.text: Anneliese Brandt is sitting with a clinical coach in the quiet room. Ostrander took his break at 15:20 and is back on queue. The 3rd and 4th call-in counselors have just badged in at the lobby security desk.

voiceStyles.State 988 Coordinator: Woman in her 50s, state official, clipped and controlled, under visible time pressure but not hostile
voiceStyles.Text message, Dana Whitcomb, state backu: Read flatly by the facilitator, as a text read off a phone screen
voiceStyles.Note from the quiet room, handed to the: Read quietly by the facilitator, as a handwritten note passed over the rail

instructorNote: This pressure inject tests whether the group sets a clear command structure, sends written status upward and looks after staff during the Level 3 surge and the text-platform problem. Look for: the ED saying the ED commands and the SC runs the floor, then sending a written status that gives counts only, by contact type, by 16:05; the SC telling the backup center to keep its share and explaining the platform issue while the TM checks the duplicate pickups; the WFC reporting confirmed headcount and holding some call-ins back for the evening; and the DCO setting up a wellbeing check with Dr. Park for Anneliese Brandt.
